data.name: Breaking And Wintering
data.detailed_description:
Santa Claus is dead, AND YOU KILLED HIM... After running over the big man, players are blackmailed into delivering his presents before the police catch up to them. Working against the clock and an ever-dwindling Christmas spirit that can be used to power the sleigh and tools, players must strategize and work together to infiltrate and deliver as many presents as they can while avoiding any collateral damage. But be careful, not everyone on Santa's list is nice...

By Purchasing this game, you and your friends will be thrown into Santa's sleigh with the goal of delivering all of his remaining presents.

The neighborhoods you visit are procedurally generated, so every delivery provides a different set of challenges and a unique environment to explore. NPC's and their behaviors also vary, so every family reacts differently to players' actions.

In order to deliver presents properly and escape, players will be tasked with stealthily entering houses, avoiding the tenants, and minimizing collateral damage.

Using points scored from delivering presents, players can purchase and upgrade items to help them accomplish their missions!

Features:

  • Custom Assets

  • Procedural Environment

  • NPC Interactions

  • Tool Purchasing And Upgrading

  • Steam Achievements

  • Proximity Chat

  • Online Co-op

data.short_description: Work with your friends to create a plan to deliver presents without getting caught (Because you aren't Santa). Manage resources like Time and Christmas Spirit to help take you and your party further into the game!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Sure!
  • Graphics: Up To You (Scalable graphics)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: For the most part, players just break into NPCs houses, and the npcs can get injured, but that is not the goal of the game, rather its an aspect of realism.
